evidence.observation: Tube pressure rising monotonically through growth: 3.07→3.13→3.23→3.26 Torr since t=2520, ~6% above the steady ~3.05 Torr held during ramp
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow increase
Exhaust O2 stays at 2-5 ppm, arguing against an air in-leak
Temperature at setpoint 750 °C with stable heater power ~46%, so not thermal expansion runaway

args.missing_evidence: Whether pressure continues to climb (conductance loss) and how P responds to a deliberate Ar flow step or brief flow cutoff; a reference band for P during growth
